jurisdiction.name: Ecuador
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Ecuador governs AI through the telecommunications ministry's (MINTEL) Strategy for the Ethical and Responsible Development and Use of AI 2025-2029, in force since its publication in the Official Register in January 2026, and through a 2023 ministerial order creating an AI committee. The data protection authority (SPDP) issued a binding 2026 rule applying the 2021 data protection law to AI systems, and a policy on AI use in its own administrative processes. The 2021 law itself regulates automated decisions. An AI regulatory sandbox has been announced and an AI bill is pending in the National Assembly.
lead_institutions: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información (MINTEL)
Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales (SPDP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from documents read in full on official sites. The Official Register's search and the government consultation portal could not be used, so the 2025 consultation draft of the strategy is recorded without its text being read. The pending AI bill and the announced AI sandbox are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Estrategia para el Fomento del Desarrollo y Uso Ético y Responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial en el Ecuador
instruments.english_title: Strategy for Promoting the Development and Ethical and Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in Ecuador
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society (MINTEL), by Ministerial Agreement MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
instruments.current_status: Issued by Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030, signed 22 December 2025 and published in the Registro Oficial, Primer Suplemento No. 206, 19 January 2026, when the agreement entered into force. Presented officially by the minister on 10 March 2026. The Viceministry of ICT and the Undersecretariat for the Information Society and Digital Economy are charged with monitoring and periodic updating. MINTEL also publishes the signed agreement and annexes separately on its site (uploads 2026/01).
instruments.summary: Ecuador's first national AI strategy (EFIA), issued by Ministerial Agreement MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030 with a four-year horizon (2025-2029) and coordinated by MINTEL as governing body for digital transformation. It sets eleven guiding principles (including human oversight, transparency, information security and a risk-based approach) and three axes: AI governance (ethics, social and labour impact, risk management including an inventory of AI systems in operation), capacity and technology (talent, cloud infrastructure, data), and AI adoption and development (R&D, startups, technology free zones, a regulatory sandbox for emerging technologies, public-sector AI). Each line of action has initiatives with indicators and targets assigned to public bodies.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current national AI strategy and the anchor of Ecuador's AI governance model; basis for the MINTEL AI regulatory sandbox.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): MINTEL-hosted copy of Registro Oficial Primer Suplemento No. 206 (19 January 2026) read in full (pdftotext; 63 pages): Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030 signed 22 December 2025, in force on publication in the Registro Oficial, with the strategy annex. Same issue also read on the Constitutional Court's gazette repository (esacc.corteconstitucional.gob.ec). Launch confirmed on MINTEL press release No. 084 of 10 March 2026.

instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society (MINTEL)

instruments.summary: Ministerial agreement ordering the actions needed to create the Artificial Intelligence Committee as a consultation, coordination and articulation mechanism to promote the implementation, monitoring and evaluation of AI development strategies in Ecuador. The committee may include public bodies, the private sector, civil society, academia and citizens, and acts under the Organic Law for Digital and Audiovisual Transformation; MINTEL's Undersecretariat for the Information Society and Digital Economy is charged with its creation.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Founding instrument of Ecuador's multi-stakeholder AI Committee, whose recommendations produced the national AI strategy.

instruments.official_title: Norma General para la Garantía del Derecho de Protección de Datos Personales en el Uso de Sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial
instruments.english_title: General Rule Guaranteeing the Right to Personal Data Protection in the Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems (Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R)
instruments.issuing_authority: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (SPDP), Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R
instruments.current_status: Signed 12 February 2026; it enters into force on publication in the Registro Oficial, which secondary sources report as Registro Oficial No. 240 of 10 March 2026 (not confirmed on an official site). A draft reform clarifying processors' obligations (limited to operations where they have access to or control over the data) was posted by the SPDP in June 2026 (see leads).
instruments.summary: Binding SPDP rule applying the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection to controllers and processors that develop, train, implement, deploy or provide AI systems processing personal data of Ecuadorian data subjects, wherever the system or provider is located. They must inform data subjects clearly about AI-based and automated processing, carry out risk management and impact assessments before development, apply security measures, enter AI processing and automated decisions with legal or rights effects in the record of processing activities, and audit AI systems according to risk; the right not to be subject to automated decisions is guaranteed. The SPDP may audit AI systems and impose corrective and precautionary measures.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Ecuador's main binding AI-specific rule; defines developer, deployer, distributor and implementer roles for data-protection obligations.
metadata_gaps: Effective date (Registro Oficial publication not confirmed on an official source)

instruments.official_title: Política para el Desarrollo y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial en Procesos Administrativos de la Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales
instruments.english_title: Policy for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Administrative Processes of the Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R)
instruments.issuing_authority: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection (SPDP), Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R
instruments.current_status: Approved by Resolution SPDP-SPD-2026-0007-R, signed 9 February 2026 and in force on signature; binding within the SPDP only. The annexed policy is dated 30 December 2025.
instruments.summary: Mandatory internal policy for all SPDP authorities, staff and units on developing and using AI in the regulator's administrative processes. It sets governance roles for in-house agentic AI and expert systems (organisational lead, agentic-AI lead, development and security leads, with audit rights for the information security officer and data protection officer), lists the activities for which agentic and generative AI may be used, and requires risk management for both covering data protection, fairness, accuracy and robustness, explainability and information security.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First published public-sector AI-use policy of an Ecuadorian state body; covers generative AI use by officials.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): signed resolution and annex PDFs embedded on spdp.gob.ec/resolucionia/ read in full (pdftotext); signed 9 February 2026, in force on signature.

instruments.official_title: Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales
instruments.english_title: Organic Law on Personal Data Protection
instruments.current_status: Published in the Registro Oficial, Quinto Suplemento No. 459, 26 May 2021, in force on publication. Amended since (consolidated text lists the last reform on 22 May 2026); implemented by the General Regulation and SPDP secondary rules.
instruments.summary: Ecuador's comprehensive data protection law, applying to public and private processing of personal data and creating the Superintendency of Personal Data Protection as supervisory authority. Article 20 gives data subjects the right not to be subject to decisions based solely or partly on automated assessments, including profiling, that produce legal effects or affect their fundamental rights, with rights to a reasoned explanation, to submit observations, to obtain the evaluation criteria and data sources, and to challenge the decision.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Legal basis for regulating AI that processes personal data, including the SPDP's 2026 AI rule.
instruments.evidence_reference: curl (browser user agent, --max-time 60): MINTEL-hosted scan of Registro Oficial Quinto Suplemento No. 459 (26 May 2021) confirmed title, issue and date (image PDF, 70 pages, no text layer); article text (art. 20 and final provision) read from the consolidated text also hosted on telecomunicaciones.gob.ec (2026/06, LEXIS-sourced consolidation, last reform 22 May 2026).

organizations.name: Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Society
organizations.ai_governance_role: Ministerio de Telecomunicaciones y de la Sociedad de la Información (MINTEL): governing body for telecommunications, the information society and digital transformation. Issued the national AI strategy (Acuerdo MINTEL-MINTEL-2025-0030) and the 2023 order creating the AI Committee, coordinates AI governance under the strategy and is leading the design of an AI regulatory sandbox.

organizations.name: Superintendency of Personal Data Protection
organizations.ai_governance_role: Superintendencia de Protección de Datos Personales (SPDP): data protection supervisory authority created by the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection. Issued the general rule on data protection in the use of AI systems (SPDP-SPD-2026-0009-R), may audit AI systems processing personal data, and adopted an internal AI-use policy.

organizations.name: National Assembly
organizations.ai_governance_role: Asamblea Nacional: unicameral legislature; enacted the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection (2021). AI bills: the Proyecto de Ley Orgánica de Regulación y Promoción de Inteligencia Artificial was archived by the Plenary on 15 September 2026; a new AI governance bill was filed on 1 September 2026.

No deepfake offence enacted (only proposed in the pending bill).; Government: MINTEL site and media library: national AI strategy (2026), its consultation draft (2025), AI Committee order (2023); Digital Transformation Policy 2025-2030 (lead, AI in passing); AI sandbox announced, no instrument yet.; Ministries: Education, justice/judiciary (Consejo de la Judicatura), and other ministries searched via web search: searched, nothing found.
